subject: اللغة الإنجليزية
unit: Across Cultures · Reading for Pleasure · Review and Reference
lesson: Reading for Pleasure: interview with celebrity chef Issa Al Lamki
outcomes: Read an interview and answer questions about a chef's career
Explain why passion and hard work matter for success

tf.s: Issa Al Lamki trained at the National Hospitality Institute (NHI) in Muscat.
tf.why: His training began at the NHI in Muscat.

tf.s: Issa Al Lamki returned to Oman in 2008.
tf.why: The interview gives 2008 as the year he came back.

tf.s: It took him ten years to become a top executive chef.
tf.why: He did it in seven years, earlier than his 10-year target.

tf.s: Fusion cooking blends Omani ingredients with classic recipes from other countries.
Issa Al Lamki believes that if you have a passion for your work, nothing is impossible.
tf.why: This is his main advice in the interview.

tf.s: He became a top executive chef by 2003.
Fusion cooking means using only one country's recipes without any changes.
tf.why: Fusion cooking mixes ingredients and recipes from different places.

tf.s: Issa Al Lamki wanted to hide Omani cooking from the world.
tf.why: He aimed to promote Omani cooking.

tf.s: Issa Al Lamki reached his goal later than he had planned.
tf.why: He reached it earlier: seven years instead of ten.

tf.s: Issa Al Lamki is famous as a tour guide.

mcq.q: What does Issa Al Lamki believe about work?
o: If you have a passion for your work, nothing is impossible
You should change jobs every year
mcq.why: Passion is the centre of his advice.

mcq.q: Which sentence best summarises Issa Al Lamki's career?
o: He trained at the NHI, became an executive chef by 2003 and returned to Oman in 2008
He became a chef in 2008 after ten years of training abroad
He has never worked outside a small café
He trained as a pilot and later became a chef
mcq.why: These are the key dates and steps in the interview.

mcq.q: What was Issa Al Lamki's aim when he returned to Oman?
o: To open a fast-food chain abroad
mcq.why: He wanted to make Omani cooking better known.

mcq.q: A chef serves Omani halwa flavours in a classic French dessert. What is this an example of?
mcq.why: It blends Omani ingredients with a recipe from another country.

mcq.q: He became an executive chef in 2003 after seven years. Around which year did he start his career?
Your group wants to promote Omani food to tourists, like Issa Al Lamki. Which idea fits best?
o: Offer tourists tasting menus of Omani fusion dishes
mcq.why: Letting tourists taste Omani dishes promotes Omani food.

mcq.q: What does reaching his goal in seven years instead of ten tell us about Issa Al Lamki?
o: He worked hard and was passionate about cooking
He did not care about his career
His target was too easy to reach
mcq.why: Reaching a goal early shows hard work and passion.

mcq.q: Why might fusion cooking help promote Omani cuisine abroad?
o: Foreign visitors taste Omani flavours in recipes they already know
It makes the food more expensive only
It is only for Omani people
mcq.why: Familiar recipes with Omani ingredients make new flavours easier to enjoy.

mcq.q: Which message from the interview is most useful for students choosing a career?
o: Choose work you are passionate about and work hard
Choose the job with the shortest training
Avoid working in your own country
mcq.why: His story shows passion and effort lead to success.
